title: Museum of BBQ

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We love hosting field trip groups at the Museum of BBQ. Our group rate discounts start at 10 students. We ask that you have 1 chaperone for every 10 students. Students learn how barbecue gets its flavor, as well as the culture and history of a food that is a key part of Kansas City’s identity. They will enjoy an immersive experience which engages their senses and curiosity. Student groups usually take between 30 and 45 minutes to explore the 10 installations. We can accommodate up to 75 students. In order to ensure everyone has space and time to move through the exhibits, we divide larger groups into smaller sections of 15 to 20
